places.name: Checkpoint Charlie
places.ai_summary: Famous crossing point between East and West Berlin during the Cold War, now a tourist attraction.

opening_hours.notes: Check for guided tour availability.

places.place_tip: Visit the museum nearby for in-depth history.

attribution.title: Berlin - Checkpoint Charlie 1963
attribution.author: Roger Wollstadt
attribution.description: Checkpoint Charlie was on Friedrichstrasse, near Kochstrasse.  It was the only crossing between West Berlin and East Berlin that could be used by Americans and other foreigners, and by members of the Allied Forces.  The other six checkpoints were for residents of West Berlin or West Germany.
